recall_at_best.question: What is the recall at the lowest threshold whose recall is still at least 0.80?
recall_at_best.reference:
thresholds = np.arange(0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
best_t = None
for t in thresholds:
    y_pred_t = (y_proba >= t).astype(int)
    if recall_score(y_test, y_pred_t) >= 0.80:
        best_t = t

y_pred_best = (y_proba >= best_t).astype(int)
prec_at_best = precision_score(y_test, y_pred_best)
rec_at_best = recall_score(y_test, y_pred_best)
